newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA RESHUFFLE DEFENCE AHEAD OF GREECE TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA RESHUFFLE DEFENCE AHEAD OF GREECE TIE.

text.p: Croatia have drafted two Zagreb-based defenders into their squad for their World Cup qualifier against Greece in Salonika on Wednesday.
Goran Juric is likely to win his second cap by replacing injured Nikola Jerkan in the libero position.

Croatia Zagreb team mate Dario Simic is expected to play in the heart of the defence alongside Slaven Bilic of England's West Ham, while Zvonimir Soldo of Germany's VfB Stuttgart, who played in Croatia's 3-3 draw against Slovenia earlier this month, will move into midfield.
In attack, coach Miroslav Blazevic will be able to field Alen Boksic of Juventus, who has fully recovered from a recent injury, and Real Madrid's top scorer Davor Suker.
After three home draws, Croatia trail Denmark and Greece in group one. They have six points from four matches and badly need a win on Wednesday.
Croatia - Drazen Ladic, Goran Juric, Dario Simic, Zvonimir Soldo, Slaven Bilic, Robert Jarni, Zvonimir Boban, Aljosa Asanovic, Robert Prosinecki, Alen Boksic, Davor Suker
